reading_guide.kind: sprite = seen as a (translucency-capable) sprite; wall = seen as a wall texture; surface = seen on floors/ceilings; maskwall = seen on masked walls. First-glance readings — a tile can legitimately appear in other kinds.
reading_guide.wiring: true = an engine/editor marker invisible in game (sound emitters, stack markers). Never counts as a visible object in object-scale mining; matches blood_types.sprite_visibility.
reading_guide.binding: Owner principle (2026-08-31): every tile->meaning rule has exceptions, and how many depends on how strong/distinctive the tile's look is. A visually singular tile (mannequin 2377) binds its meaning almost always; a generic surface (456, 202) is material that only sometimes plays an object role. The measured counterpart is Phase 2's anchor enrichment figure - high enrichment ~ strong binding. 'strong'/'weak' here is the owner's reading; leave unset where untested.
reading_guide.transparency: Owner principle (2026-09-01), MEASURED same day and it is a LAW. 'Transparency' means the special palette color drawn as see-through (palette index 255, the ART mask color) - NOT the translucency cstat render bit, which is a separate mechanism. Of 3590 tiles carrying mask pixels (>5%), exactly 0 appear on any of the campaign's 28158 non-sky floor/ceiling surface slots (43 maps). Mask-colored tiles belong to sprites and maskwalls only. Promote to a hard validator rule for authored maps; use as a usage-kind prior when assigning tiles.
reading_guide.state_pair: intact/broken or bare/overgrown tile pairs; candidate anchors for destruction/decay state mining (handbook 05).
reading_guide.dual_role: independently derived second reading elsewhere in the repo; evidence of context-dependence.
